L61: ## Membership Trial
L62: 
L63: Sophia offers a free trial for learners to try any of our courses. The trial allows you to complete the first Challenge (i.e., quiz) of any course. Once the first Challenge has been completed, you are able to continue the course by becoming a member via any one of our subscription offerings.
L64: 
L65: To start a free trial, navigate to the course you are interested in, and select 'Try this Course.'
L66: ## Membership Pricing
L67: 
L68: Sophia offers three different subscription plans:
L69: 
L70:   * 1-month membership for $99
L71:   * 4-month membership for $299
L72:   * 12-month membership for $599
L73: 
L74: ## Membership Renewal
L75: 
L76: Your membership will automatically renew at the end of the membership period for the same duration as originally selected (1-month, 4-month, or 12-month) until you decide to cancel or upgrade your membership.
L77: ## What’s Included in Your Membership
L78: 
L79: With your Sophia membership, you can take as many courses as you want, up to two at a time, at a pace that works with your schedule. You do not pay any additional cost for individual courses, and there is no time commitment to complete a course.
L80: 
L81: Additionally, there are no course registration fees or additional fees for material, textbooks or eBooks. Everything is included as part of your membership.
L82: ## Payment Methods
L83: 
L84: Sophia memberships can be purchased with a credit or debit card, Apple Pay, or Google Pay.
L85: ## Membership Upgrade
L86: 
L87: To upgrade your 1-month or 4-month Subscription Membership from your Sophia account: (1) go to “Profile”, (2) click “Change” under “Membership”, and (3) select the plan you’d like to upgrade to.
L88: 
L89: Any remaining days in your current membership period will be automatically credited toward the upgrade. We cannot apply past membership payments to membership upgrades.
L90: 
L91: You may not downgrade your Subscription Membership, but you may cancel your membership at any time.
L92: ## Membership Cancellation
L93: 
L94: You may cancel your membership at any time. To do so, go to the 【18†Membership】 section of your Profile and click 'Cancel Membership.' Note that in order to avoid being charged for your next membership term, you must cancel no less than five (5) days prior to the end of your current membership term.
L95: ## Membership Refund
L96: 
L97: If you are not satisfied within 30 days and have not completed any courses, you may request a refund. To do so, please contact a Learning Coach by email, phone, or chat.
L98: ## Membership Extensions
L99: 
L100: Sophia does not grant complimentary extensions for memberships. If you find yourself in exceptional circumstances that you believe warrant an extension, we invite you to reach out to us via email at 【19†[email protected]】 and share your situation. Before submitting a request, please be aware that Sophia will not extend memberships due to time lost from unsuccessful verification attempts or previously unused time within a membership period.
L101: If you have any billing or refund requests, please submit 【20†a request form†sophialearning.zendesk.com】 for our Billing team to review and respond to.

L127: # Grading Timelines in Online Learning: What You Need to Know
L128: 
L129: Posted on January 15, 2026
L130: 
L131: By Sophia Learning
L132: 
L133: Online learning is a great way to advance your knowledge while going through courses at your own pace. It’s a great way to supplement general education, achieve new certifications, and give you the resume boost you’re looking for when it’s time for a career change.
L134: However, if you’re new to online learning, you’ve probably wondered how exactly course grading works. Maybe you’re unsure about what types of assignments you’ll get, how they’re evaluated, and what you should be prepared for when it comes to overall grading timelines.
L135: 
L136: We’ll go over each of these details to give you a better perspective before starting your online learning journey.
L137: ## Types of Assignments with Online Learning
L138: 
L139: Taking courses online typically looks a bit different than what you’ll find in a traditional classroom setting. While each online course is different, and many have their own formats, most feature a mix of assignments and practical exercises designed for remote students.
L140: 
L141: Some of the most common assignment formats you’ll see include:
L142: ### Timed Tests and Quizzes
L143: 
L144: Structured tests or quizzes are the most common types of assignments you’ll find in remote learning courses. At Sophia Learning, these are referred to as “Milestones.” These are typically 20-30 questions long, multiple choice and are designed to help gauge key concepts a student should have learned.
L145: 
L146: Because these quizzes have fixed answers, they’re typically graded automatically on the platform and will provide an overview of how you scored shortly after taking the quizzes.
L147: ### Written Assignments or Projects
L148: 
L149: For more in-depth assignments that require more critical thinking, many courses include various written assignments or projects. At Sophia Learning, these are called “Touchstones.” These types of assignments give you the chance to apply what you’ve learned, usually by presenting you with real-world problems and allowing you to work through them.
L150: These assignments are scored manually and will count toward your total course grading averages. The great thing about these types of assignments is that you can typically work on them at your own pace and have much more flexible turnaround times.
L151: ### Discussion Boards
L152:

L57: ## Typing DNA Verification
L58: 
L59: Typing DNA Verification is used to confirm a student’s identity by analyzing their unique typing pattern.
L60: 
L61: Steps for the Typing DNA Verification:
L62:   * You will type a sample passage or set of characters to establish your typing pattern at the beginning of a course.
L63:   * The software records and analyzes your typing rhythm, speed, and other variables to create a unique typing pattern.
L64:   * When prompted for the typing verification in an attempt to access a milestone, you will be prompted to type the same passage to verify your identity. With this, be sure that you are clicking the continue button that is shown on the verification page. Do not press the enter or return key on your keyboard when you’re finished typing the passage.
L65:   * The software then compares your typing pattern to the previously established pattern to confirm your identity.
L66:   * If the verification is successful, you may continue to your intended milestone.
L67: ## Having Trouble with the Typing DNA Verification?
L68: 
L69: Here is a list of the variables that are measured during the typing pattern analysis. Being mindful of these variable will hopefully assist you in consistently passing this verification:
L70:   * The time between releasing a key and pressing the next key.
L71:   * The pattern and speed of your keystrokes.
L72:   * The frequency and type of errors you make while typing.
L73:   * The overall speed at which you type.
L74: If you encounter issues with the typing DNA verification, please contact our Learning Coach team for assistance.
L75: 
L76: Each of these verification processes are used across various industries and services to uphold academic integrity and confirm the identity of their users.
L77: ## SMS Verification
L78: 
L79: SMS Verification is used to confirm a student’s identity by sending a unique code to their mobile phone number via SMS. The SMS is made available after failing the first two attempts of your typing pattern verification.
L80: 
L81: After clicking the SMS option after failing the 2nd typing DNA Verification attempt, these would be the steps for the SMS verification:
L82: 
L83: When used, a verification code to the phone number that you have listed within your profile on Sophia.
L84: You will then enter the code when prompted in Sophia.
L85: 
L86: After entering the code, you will be able to move on to your milestone.
L87: 
L88: Generally, the SMS verification option is only available if the phone number you’ve provided is based in the United States.
L89: ## Jumio Verification
L90: 
L91: You may be prompted to provide an ID for verification through Jumio. Jumio verification is used to confirm a student's identity by verifying their government-issued ID and comparing it to a subsequent selfie.
L92: 
L93: Here are the Jumio verification steps:
L94:   1. You will be prompted to submit your government issued ID to Jumio.
L95:   2. You will then be prompted to take a selfie, which Jumio will compare with the photo on the government issued ID.
L96:   3. Jumio verifies that the information on the ID matches your selfie.
L97:   4. If the verification is successful, you may proceed with the final milestone and mark the course as complete. If the verification is not successful, you will need to repeat the process until you have successfully been verified. You will not be able to continue otherwise.
L98: TIP: In the United States, a valid passport, driver's license, or ID card are all accepted Jumio ID types. If you are outside the United States, 【14†please refer to this PDF】 for accepted IDs.
L99: ## Having Trouble with the Jumio Verification?
L100: 
L101: By following the tips below, you can increase the likelihood of a successful Jumio verification and minimize any errors that may occur during the process.
L102:   * Good lighting. When taking the selfie or live video, make sure the lighting is sufficient and does not cast any shadows on your face.
L103:   * Follow the instructions carefully. Jumio provides clear instructions on what you need to do during the verification process.
L104:   * If possible, use a high-quality camera. A low-quality camera should still work, but may result in poor image quality, making it difficult for Jumio to match your facial features with the ID document.
L105:   * When taking a picture of your ID, make sure it is positioned correctly and all information is visible. The ID should not be tilted or skewed, and there should be no reflections or glare on the document.
L106:   * Ensure you have a stable internet connection before starting the verification process to avoid any interruptions.
L107:   * Try to avoid using busy or distracting backgrounds that may interfere with the Jumio’s ability to verify your identity.
L108: The Jumio verification process may take a few minutes to complete. Please wait for the system to confirm your identity before closing the window.
